description: Full reported holdings of one of six iShares index-tracking ETFs (IVV, IJH, IJR, IWB, IWM, EFA) as of the fund's own "as of" date — every position including cash, collateral and futures, each labeled with its asset class so they are never silently mixed in with equities. Answers "what does IVV actually hold today", "how much cash does this ETF carry". For just the equity index membership, use index_constituents instead.

asset_class.description: Optional filter, case-insensitive exact match against the fund's own asset-class label (e.g. "Equity", "Cash", "Futures", "Cash Collateral and Margins", "Money Market").

limit.description: Max rows to return, sorted by market value descending (default 50, max 600).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging past `limit` (default 0).

ticker.description: One of the supported iShares ETFs: IVV, IJH, IJR, IWB, IWM, EFA.

name: ishares_etf_holdings
title: Ishares Etf Holdings
